Hi Kira — congrats on the signed SOW. Attaching a working MAP that embeds the post-signature implementation plan and a compact canary plan. High level below; full MAP attached (Stellar_MAP_v1.xlsx).

Summary (close -> live):
- Week 0 (Jul 6): Close acknowledged; kickoff call; intake of access artifacts (VPN, service accounts). Owner: Stellar / Vivek.
- Week 1 (Jul 13): Environment provisioning + integration smoke tests (non-prod). Owner: Redwood infra.
- Week 2 (Jul 20): Training wave 1 (ops & support) + validation baseline.
- Week 3 (Jul 27): Canary rollout (1% traffic for 72 hours) + telemetry review. Rollback gates documented.
- Week 4 (Aug 3): Gradual ramp to 30% with daily checkpoints; full ramp to 100% by Aug 10 if gates pass.

Training: 2 live sessions (60–90m) + recorded short runbook. Proposed slots in attached Training_Schedule_v0.3.pdf.
Canary details: short window, explicit rollback criteria (error spike > 2x baseline OR sustained latency > 150ms at p95), automatic fallback to prior model variant. Canary checklist attached (Canary-run-checklist.docx).

Next steps:
1) Confirm two training attendee lists and preferred times by Wed 7/8.
2) Confirm procurement/invoice contact so we can schedule environment provisioning immediately.
3) Kickoff call — propose Wed 7/8 10:00am PT (30m).

I’ll also share the HubSpot deal and DocuSign links for the signed artifacts.

— Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Adding operational detail from my side — highlights and asks for Stellar ops: 

Canary window specifics (proposed):
- Start: Mon 7/27 09:00 PT
- Length: 72 hours continuous (will accept scheduled brief pause for maintenance if needed)
- Scope: US production traffic routed to canary pool (1% token weight)
- Monitoring: p50/p95 latency, error rate, token throughput, token cost per minute, and KV cache hit ratio.
- Decision points: 24h and 72h review — red/amber/green with explicit rollback/hold instructions.

Training plan (ops):
- Session A (Intro + runbooks): Tue 7/21 11:00–12:15 PT — live walk-through, Q&A.
- Session B (Troubleshooting + escalations): Thu 7/23 09:00–10:30 PT — playbook rehearsals.
- Deliverables: 15-min trimmed recording, runbook doc, Slack channel invite for after-hours incidents.

Integration checklist: we need service account with logging write, read-only DB credentials for validation, and a test dataset (anonymized). Please provide by Fri 7/10 EOD.
